verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Apify running scraping Actors such as apify/web-scraper on supplied start URLs, and a TikTok scraper that accepts search queries. Nothing documents a web-search capability that returns full page content from the results in one call. Generic Actor-running and crawling primitives are building blocks a developer could combine, not the requested capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search the web and get full page content from results in a single call instead of just links and snippets
